product_name: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 5G (Titanium Black, 12GB RAM, 256GB Storage)
description: MULTIPLE TASKS WITH ONE ASK: Streamline your day with an assistant that gets you. Ask it to Google search for a pet-friendly vegan restaurant nearby and text it to your friend— your Galaxy S25 Ultra handles multiple tasks with a single ask. START THE DAY SMARTER: Stay one step ahead with a phone that gives you the info you need before you even know you need it with Now Brief. REDUCE THE NOISE. REVEAL THE MAGIC: AI Camera with Audio Eraser lets you capture vibrant videos in low light and minimize unwanted noises so you can relive your favorite moments with fewer distractions. BRING OUT THE BEST IN EVERY FACE: Capture every portrait with clarity and confidence on the Galaxy S25 Ultra. The advanced portrait features adjust skin tones and preserve natural textures, giving every shot a polished, professional look. SWITCHING IS QUICK & EASY: With Smart Switch, you can move your pics, videos, music, apps, contacts and convos to their new home, safely and securely, in just a few simple steps.
